attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Will Create Teeth System. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. UprTeeth: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. LwrTeeth: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). SetUprParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. SetLwrParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: Jaw_Jnt, Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl. Template attrs-position examples: Vis_Ctrl, Lips_Center_Ctrl, Jaw_Ctrl.
